domain.name: Fact Verification with Multi-Hop Retrieval
domain.content_type: Claim verification summaries and reasoning over Wikipedia passages
domain.task_complexity: Requires tracing complex multi-entity relationships across multiple retrieval hops, identifying missing evidence, and determining when passages are insufficient for verification

domain_terminology.meaning: Process of retrieving documents in three sequential steps, where each retrieval builds on previous findings
Hop-based Verification dataset for fact-checking claims requiring multi-hop reasoning
Wikipedia passages that contain information needed to verify a claim
Named entities, relationships, and facts within a claim that require verification
When provided passages lack critical evidence needed for complete verification

common_error_patterns.name: incomplete_entity_extraction
common_error_patterns.description: Failing to identify all entities in a claim that need verification (e.g., missing 'American' vs 'South American' distinction for Olivia Munn)

common_error_patterns.name: broken_hop_chain
common_error_patterns.description: Not following the logical chain of entities across hops (e.g., Alec Utgoff → film → Olivia Munn → model career)

common_error_patterns.name: missing_evidence_identification
common_error_patterns.description: Failing to recognize when passages don't contain critical information needed for verification

common_error_patterns.name: false_verification
common_error_patterns.description: Claiming verification is possible when key evidence is missing from passages
detection_hints: claim contains facts not in passages
contradiction between claim and passages not noted

common_error_patterns.name: author_vs_work_confusion
common_error_patterns.description: Confusing the author of a work with the work itself (e.g., 'Baifa Monü Zhuan' is a novel by Liang Yusheng, not an author)

common_error_patterns.name: temporal_calculation_errors
common_error_patterns.description: Incorrect calculation of time differences (e.g., '12 years before Pete's Dragon')

common_error_patterns.name: incomplete_summary_for_retrieval
common_error_patterns.description: Producing summaries that don't explicitly list all entities/concepts needed for next retrieval hop
detection_hints: implicit rather than explicit entity mentions

correctness_criteria.description: All entities, relationships, and facts in claim must be identified and listed
correctness_criteria.how_to_verify: Check that every noun phrase and relationship in claim is addressed

correctness_criteria.description: Full chain of entities across all three hops must be traced
correctness_criteria.how_to_verify: Verify each entity connects logically to the next in the retrieval sequence

correctness_criteria.description: Must explicitly identify when passages lack critical evidence for verification
correctness_criteria.how_to_verify: Compare claim requirements against passage content, note missing documents

correctness_criteria.description: Claims must be checked against passage content for contradictions or confirmations
correctness_criteria.how_to_verify: Direct comparison of claim facts with passage statements

correctness_criteria.description: Summary must provide explicit, actionable guidance for next retrieval step
correctness_criteria.how_to_verify: Summary contains specific entity names, relationships, and search concepts
